author: reek
body: Test runner for the Codex OS. TestRunner compiles and runs test samples natively -- no QEMU, no PS1, no TCP sockets. The compiler is a process on the OS; tests are compiled by spawning the compiler and collecting output.

author: reek
body: TestRunner replaces run-for-sweep.ps1 + the sweep worker scriptblock. On bare metal with the scheduler, each test is a child process.
